understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a `+` was occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, which triggers WIN and advances until the full game is completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level. Arrow moves (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) would move the currently selected piece one tile in that direction unless blocked by walls/obstacles or other blocking rules; pushing would only work if the adjacent object was pushable and the space beyond it was free (otherwise the move is blocked). CLICK selected (and in some cases teleported/swapped) between selectable pieces by targeting their coordinates; trying to CLICK or move into blocked tiles had no effect but still consumed a step.
